remarks: Living is easy in this furnished Greens Farms neighborhood home. Furnished rental available Oct 15, 2025 to May 15, 2026. Contemporary ranch offers open, spacious rooms.  Lovely fireplace in the ample living room. Large country kitchen opens to family room with fireplace and a wall of glass sliders. Formal dining area opens to an enclosed porch overlooking peaceful grounds. Tennis court on the property is available for play. Convenient to train, close to beach and shopping. Perfect for someone who needs a place while their home is being renovated or a great a home base while searching for your dream home.   References, credit and full background check are a must. Tenant responsible for all utilities, 2 Months Security Deposit. No pets preferred and definitely no cats. No smoking. 6 month lease preferred. Owner will not lease past May 15, 2026
